name: Temporary work visa (project-based, multiple-entry consultant visa)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a Saudi entity to sponsor the visit for a specific, time-bound project, consultancy, or specialist assignment, distinct from an ordinary employment contract.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a project-based sponsorship from a Saudi entity for the specific engagement.

requirements.blocker_text: Limited to consultants, specialists, and project managers on defined assignments; it is not a substitute for the standard Employment Visa for ongoing, indefinite roles.
requirements.fix_path: Use the standard Employment Visa (sa_employment_visa) for ongoing indefinite employment instead.

evidence_required.document: Project or consultancy contract with defined scope and duration
Medical examination for each entry where required

outcome.duration_length: up to 180 days per entry, multiple entries within a 12-month validity

sources.title: Multiplier -- Saudi Arabia work visa types, describing the temporary/project work visa's 180-day-per-entry, 12-month multiple-entry structure
Worldwide RS -- Saudi Arabia Work Permits and Visas 2026, independent corroboration distinguishing temporary/seasonal visas from the standard Employment Visa and Iqama track
